meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把消息渠道接到 agent group 上:登记渠道、选择隔离级别、添加新的渠道群组、改接已有 wiring,并按需展示配置摘要。
howto.when: 在你添加渠道之后、配置过程中,或想单独重配时接管;若实例还没有 owner,它会先让你跑 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 把新的 Telegram 群接到我的 agent 上
say.note: 会问隔离方式，再登记并创建 wiring
列出 agent group、已接/未接渠道、特权用户

say.text: 把这个渠道改接到另一个 agent group
say.note: 删旧 wiring 建新的，旧会话留在原组

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude wires messaging channels to agent groups: registers channels, picks an isolation level, adds new channel groups, changes existing wirings, and shows a config summary on request.
howto.when_en: Takes over after you add a channel, during setup, or standalone when you want to reconfigure. If the instance has no owner yet, it first points you to /init-first-agent.

say_en.text: Wire the new Telegram group to my agent
say_en.note: It asks the isolation question, then registers and wires
Lists agent groups, wired/unwired channels, privileged users

say_en.text: Move this channel to another agent group
say_en.note: Deletes old wiring, makes a new one; old sessions stay
